nom: The Ordinary Salicylic Acid 2% Masque Clarifying Charcoal & Clay Mask for Blemish Prone Skin

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin, including some who limit use to their T-zone, generally report the mask reduces blackheads, congestion and oiliness with regular use.
segments.dry: The mask is described as too drying for naturally dry skin by some reviewers, though one reviewer with very dry, compromised skin found it calmed redness and left her skin smooth on first use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report mixed results, from clearer, smoother skin to one reviewer whose combination/oily skin broke out all over after using it.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are mostly positive when using it sparingly, once a week or less, reporting no irritation or redness, though a few describe stinging, swelling or redness, including one reviewer whose skin had never reacted to anything before.

concerns.dehydration: The mask is widely described as drying, especially with frequent use or on naturally dry skin; several reviewers manage this by limiting use to once a week or moisturizing heavily afterward, while a couple with very dry or compromised skin say it improved their skin's smoothness and healed a rough, cracked texture.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report temporary redness, stinging or puffiness right after use, sometimes lasting a few hours to a day, including one whose skin had never reacted to any product before; other reviewers say it reduced their baseline redness and inflammation.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report clearer skin with fewer blackheads and breakouts after consistent weekly use, including several managing hormonal or cystic acne; two reviewers say it made their skin break out instead of helping.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin generally use the mask on their T-zone or oiliest areas and report reduced shine and oil buildup with regular use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer using the mask on hyperpigmentation and rough texture left by past acne describes it as a holy grail for smoothing and evening out those marks.

aspects.libelle: Can stain sebaceous filaments or fabric
Leaves skin smooth right after rinsing
Formula or texture seems inconsistent between batches

extraits.texte: I bought this in the beginning of the year and tried it twice - unfortunately it absolutely did not work for me and made me break out all over (both times). My skin feels really sensitive days after I've used it. I actually really love products by the ordinary but this just was not made for me I guess.

I've used this mask three times over two weeks to give it a proper try but it just made my skin breakout all over. Before using it I didn't have any breakouts, just texture and clogged pores but I had decided to get the balance set since I already used all the products in it and the mask was the only new one I had not tried. I don't know if maybe it's just not right for myself, I have an oily/combination skin but now that my skin is breaking out I'm just hoping that it will calm down soon.

extraits.titre: First product to irritate my skin!
extraits.texte: I have hardy skin. Nothing bothers it. This product caused my first reaction ever. Skin was raised, swollen and inflamed. Wherever the product was, that skin became horribly red and puffy.

extraits.titre: Good for acne and oily skin
extraits.texte: I have acne prone and oily skin. I use this mask twice a week and it helps with clearing the congestion on my nose and chin. I notice my skin is not as smooth if I do not use this mask at least once a week. It is not 100% acne prevention but it keeps my pores cleaner. I won't rebuy bc I see faster better results with leave on products. The consistency is like dried out toothpaste and you have to really squeeze it to get it out. The consistency is fine and has not separated on me. I do not recommend it for those with dry skin.

extraits.titre: The best exfoliator for my skin
extraits.texte: First of all: I have combination and sensitive skin, with a lot of blemishes (never had acne), black heads, and redness. I tried chemical exfoliators for the first time 2 years ago. The Ordinary AHA + BHA Peeling Solution gave me irritation and redness, even when I used it carefully. It was just not the right one for my skin. But this one...this one is really my thing! Helped me a lot with my stubborn black heads and uneven tone. The skin feels smooth and soft the next day. I used it with the niacinamide serum and the natural moisturising factors cream, as the guideline suggested. The results were amazing, I never felt a skincare regimen more suitable for me. Obviously you have to wear sunscreen while using this product. My only concern is the fact that the product expires in 6 months after opening it. I would really like to purchase che 100ml one, but i know i won't be albe to use and finish it in 6 months (i finished the 50ml one in 5 months).

For a couple of months my skin has been very dry with incredibly rough surface. Back in September it crackled even and was bleeding a bit. No cream or serum could be absorbed. They made things even worse, all my trusty ordinary & hylamide products didn't work how they used to. I couldn't do anything about the rough surface of the skin. Plus the skin was so sensible to everything - it itched and burned. Well this masque is a miracle. Directly after first use, so after 10 minutes and rinsing, the redness was almost gone. The skin was smooth!! And buffet was immediately absorbed! Really, I couldn't believe it. So now, by using this masque and slowly hydrating my skin I wait until the skin is healed completely. This couldn't have been possible without this masque. And even on my complicated skin the masque did not burn at all :) thank you, Deciem! Very happy you are around))))
